interactions.action: Initiates international wire transfer by entering beneficiary details (name, IBAN, BIC), amount, currency, purpose code, and charges type. Completes SCA (FIDO2 biometric or TOTP with dynamic linking).
interactions.touchpoint: Corporate portal payments screen or H2H API submission
information_received: Validation feedback (BIC not found, balance insufficient)

interactions.action: Reviews FX quotation showing exchange rate, all-in cost, and GBP equivalent. Accepts or declines the quote within the validity window.
Waits during compliance checks. No action required unless high-value SCA re-verification is triggered.
information_provided: Second SCA if dual-authorisation threshold exceeded

interactions.action: No direct interaction. Portal may show 'Preparing SWIFT message'.
No direct interaction. Portal shows 'Transfer in progress'.
information_received: SWIFT reference and gpi UETR displayed

interactions.action: Monitors transfer status via portal tracker. Views gpi status updates. Receives completion push notification and email.
interactions.touchpoint: Corporate portal gpi tracker; push notification; email
information_received: Completion notification with UETR and SWIFT reference
Transfer confirmation PDF available for download

interactions.action: Notified when a transfer is fraud-blocked (EX-002). Reviews case with PER-054 (Fraud Analyst). May contact PER-002 to verify the transfer legitimacy.
information_provided: Decision on legitimate vs fraudulent intent (for case resolution)

interactions.action: Receives alert when TransferFailed (EVT-057) is published with failure_reason = sanctions_block. Reviews screening result via SVC-103 audit log (MLRO-only access). Determines whether OFSI notification is required within 14 days.
information_received: Sanctions hit details (entity matched, list matched, beneficiary details)

interactions.action: Consumes EVT-049 (InternationalTransferInitiated). Performs concurrent fan-out sanctions screening of beneficiary (name, IBAN, BIC) and all correspondent BICs against OFSI, UN, EU, and OFAC lists. Publishes EVT-051 (TransferSanctionsScreened) with consolidated outcome.
Consumes EVT-049. Runs corporate wire fraud ML model. Publishes EVT-052 (TransferFraudScored) with risk_score, risk_level, and model_version.
Consumes EVT-054 (SWIFTMessageSent). Debits BusinessAccount.balance by gbp_equivalent. Publishes intra-CAP-002 BusinessAccountDebited event.
Receives pacs.008 MX message from SVC-010 via SAA Cloud. Routes through correspondent chain. Returns gpi ACSP (acceptance) and subsequently ACCC (final credit) status updates.
Receives pacs.008 from SWIFT network. Processes and routes to next hop or beneficiary bank. Returns gpi ACSP. May return pacs.002 RJCT if the beneficiary account is invalid.
